title: Thunder's Edge content switched off
description: The product no longer plays Thunder's Edge content (the expedition, the breakthroughs, the Thunder's Edge printings in the decks): the server refuses a table that asks for it with a reason, the lobby and the offline setup have no switch, and a saved game that carries it is refused on load. The Thunder's Edge strategy card set ('te') is not content and stays the default. Before shots show the forms as they were (TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the commit before the change, committed under before/); after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- HK. Synthetic mocked pages and a mocked server, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Before: online table form (desktop)
shots.caption: The form that creates a table had the row 'Thunder's Edge content' under the strategy cards.

shots.heading: After: online table form (desktop)
shots.caption: The row is gone. The strategy cards select still offers the Thunder's Edge cards ('te', the default), the Prophecy of Kings cards and the base game.

shots.heading: Before: offline setup (desktop)
shots.caption: The offline setup form had the same row.

shots.heading: Before: lobby of a table with the content on (desktop)
shots.caption: A table that had the content on said so under the strategy cards.

shots.heading: After: the same lobby (desktop)
shots.caption: Even if a server still reports the old flag, the page shows no Thunder's Edge row; the strategy cards row stays. Starting such a lobby is refused by the server with the reason.

shots.heading: A refused table (desktop)
shots.caption: An older client (or a script) that still asks the server for the content gets the reason in the form's message, not a parse error.

notes.title: Server
notes.text: POST /api/games with thunders_edge true, or with the start preset 'expedition' (any suffix), answers 400 with the reason; the lobby settings route refuses switching it on. A saved game or lobby whose initial state carries the content is reported as refused on recovery (StorageError::Disabled) and its files are kept. The wasm host refuses a start or a resume the same way.

notes.title: Older saves
notes.text: A game of a rules version below the newest (every alpha game, every game of the live branch before the flip) is refused at creation, load, recovery, replay and resume with 'this game was saved with an older version of the rules'. No list, no viewer, no deletion screen: the files stay where they are.

notes.title: Retired captures
notes.text: FP-thunders-edge-expedition (the expedition in the turn bar) cannot be taken any more and is marked retired in its manifest.
